owner: Series4; current redacted execution and comp job owner

A.scale: c and per-DIV robust SD from all unique vehicle controls, independent of split

B.scale: c and per-DIV robust SD from training-associated vehicles only, refitted for each inner and outer training cohort

center: Median asinh(vehicle/c) within each own plate/date/DIV, applied identically to train, calibration and test. Only dose=0 responses fit centers. Where all own-board vehicle values of a feature are missing, its normalized exposed values remain undefined (NA), and existing task masks exclude them; no other board or treated value imputes that center. An entirely unscorable compound raises an error.
scale_estimator: Inherited estimator: c=positive DIV12 vehicle median/4 (else 1); SD=median across training/all vehicle plate/date within each DIV of 1.4826*MAD, minimum .05, else 1. Physical duplicate controls counted once after agreement check.
response: (asinh(raw/c)-own center)/DIV SD; clip each well to [-10,10]; retain inherited missingness and float32 aggregation.
activity_reference: inactive=1 iff full-series max absolute masked DIV-mean across concentrations/features <3; equality is active. A reference and continuous scale identical for each design across R1/R2; B references may differ by training cohort.

hill_tie.rule: lowest flattened C-order grid index among SSE <= minimum SSE + tolerance
hill_tie.tolerance: 64 * float64 epsilon * max(1, sum(W * Y**2)) per output
hill_tie.reason: Numerically stable resolution of Series3 near-ties; no grid or fitted architecture change.

rules: Two group-disjoint inner fits generate training-only out-of-fold scores. Equal-drug weighted balanced accuracy selects cutoff, lowest cutoff breaks ties. Weighted training ECDF gives absolute rank margin. Final predictor trains all and only outer-training drugs.

risk.within_drug: arithmetic mean over all substance/design rows of the group
risk.selection: first increasing lambda with (sum_g L_g(lambda)+1)/(n_calibration_drugs+1)<=alpha; otherwise lambda=1 and all fall back
risk.scope: Expected marginal drug loss under independent training and exchangeable calibration/future drug loss functions; no conditional released-error or finite-batch guarantee. Shared batches and legacy stratified folds limit a literal exchangeability claim.

intervals: Per-output 90th percentile across training drugs of the maximum absolute inner-held-out level-mean residual over their designs/targets; fixed before calibration, descriptive bands with no interval coverage theorem claimed.
designs: Five published SHA-seeded k=3 designs per substance; all C(L,3) training designs; k=3 controls excluded from exposed-well budget.
cost: An accepted design costs its measured exposed wells; fallback costs all exposed wells, reusing the initial three levels. Report both full-series and calibrated measured-only fallback denominators, plus the observed-active fallback. This is counterfactual exposed-well replay, excluding controls, repeats, failed assays and overhead.
fit_reuse: Only exact identical arm, training names, held-out inner names, stage type and frozen protocol reuse deterministic fitting outputs. Outer R1 folds2/3/4 and R2 folds2/3/4 have identical training cohorts. Inner folds remain as frozen.

planned_fits.R3: optional; no R3 fits scheduled before completing both required arms

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%, frozen fits; all labels/designs travel together
bootstrap.weight: equal identities for rates and reconstruction; pooled well-count ratio for savings

reconstruction: Absolute errors averaged over valid scalar targets within each design, then equal designs per identity and equal identities.
full_reporting_audit: Wrong full-coverage calls for each learned/fixed rule; always-active errors=inactive count; always-inactive errors=active count.
execution_order: A R1 then A R2; publish first A table immediately; B R1 then B R2; finite job ends after final summary.

expected_before_run.purpose: Planning expectations only; all outcomes reported without selection.

limitations: A uses held-out-board vehicle controls for shared c/SD; it is a common-reference diagnostic, not fully training-only deployment estimation.
B centers use deployable own-board vehicles, but its c/SD and assay references depend on training cohort.
Seven independent technical components; identity bootstrap does not represent component-level sampling uncertainty.
Fold0 composition and training size remain different. Exposure costs exclude control wells and other laboratory overhead.

prefit_amendment.reason: Resource-probe task construction encountered all-NA own-board control centers before any model fit or test metric. Undefined normalized values propagate as missing.
